title: Deterministic Part at a Deterministic Instruction
statement: Let $A$ be a nondeterministic register machine, let $l$ be a state, and suppose the instruction of $A$ at $l$ is the deterministic instruction $i$. For either Boolean value $\beta$, the deterministic part of $A$ at $l$, formed using $\beta$, is $i$.
